title: worklens board
lede: 37 small motions for the flows on the board, built from its own rules. Each one plays below. None of them is implemented yet.
vocab_p: The board already has two: the latch and the gauge tick. Three more cover every other flow. Settle is the new signature: the Dashed Inference Rule, made to move. A dashed mark closes into a solid one at the moment something becomes final.
walk_p: Six steps on a mock board. Each step names the ideas it fires. Use Step to go one at a time.
start_p: Impact against effort. The first batch is the top-left corner. Settle is one shared CSS rule, so building it once serves six ideas.
guard_p: Every idea above passes these. They come from DESIGN.md, not from taste.
guard_never: Loop. A settled board runs zero animations. pnpm test:web already asserts it.
Count up a number. A readout rolls once from the direction of change. Counting from zero fakes work.
Shake, bounce or wobble. Errors are a Fault Red line with the recovery, never a jolt.
Celebrate a click. The accept burst stays the only celebration.
Hide the state. Flair never covers a status light. Offline stays a still red dot.
Animate on the first snapshot, a filter or a decision this browser just saved. The person already sees the result.
guard_always: Reduced motion keeps the meaning. Movement goes; color, words and the dashed-to-solid change stay. Switch to Reduced above to check each card.
Exits are faster than entrances. 0.15 s out, 0.24 s in, 0.44 s for a glide.
Words with the motion. Each Echo is a short sentence a screen reader also hears through the existing role="status" regions.
A state hue means a state. Cobalt in flight, amber waiting, green proven, red failed. Flair inks only at the edge of attention.
footer: Worked example for the micro-interactions skill: the worklens board (an Effect + pi-durable work board). Screens are real captures. Function names cite assets/board/board.js, hud.js and requests.js.
